rules: HMLR July 2026 GML must be downloaded from the current official local-authority list before exact polygon acceptance
Enfield Havering and Merton routing is candidate routing evidence only and must not be promoted to exact polygon evidence
HMLR INSPIRE id 46058185 39866294 or 62045430 must be present in the downloaded current GML before geometry use
exact HMLR geometry remains EPSG:27700; reprojection is forbidden for the exact raster mask because HMLR warns of shifts up to 15m
EA National LIDAR WFS and archive URLs prove transport/source availability only; returned feature or downloaded hashed bytes are required for target lineage
EA WCS application/xml endpoint availability does not prove CoverageId or raster values
real WCS CoverageId must precede DescribeCoverage and GetCoverage
actual EA raster bytes and NoData handling are mandatory before numeric parcel statistics
actual OS Terrain50 TQ39 TQ59 TQ27 archive members and metadata are mandatory before secondary numeric crosscheck
transport DNS binary-handler XML-parser or safe-URL failures are not NO_DATA
local-authority place evidence is not parcel-boundary evidence
no numeric elevation without actual source bytes
